Reely
https://www.reely.space

A free, open-source movie and TV discovery app built on the TMDB API. Browse trending, popular and top-rated titles; filter by genre, rating, runtime, year, language, certification and streaming provider; search with ⌘K from any page; keep a watchlist and watch history; stream titles in-page through an external source you configure. Installs as a PWA.

Site: https://www.reely.space
Repo: https://github.com/Vette1123/movies-streaming-platform

Pages:
/ — Homepage: trending hero slider, trending/top-rated/popular rails
/movies — Browse movies with live-applying filters
/tv-shows — Browse TV series with live-applying filters
/genre/<slug> — Movie genre pages
/tv-shows/genre/<slug> — TV genre pages
/year/<year> — Movies by year
/tv-shows/year/<year> — TV by year
/movies/<id> — Movie detail page: cast, trailer, similar, recommendations, ratings (IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, TMDB), where to watch
/tv-shows/<id> — TV series detail page
/collection/<id> — Franchise / collection pages
/person/<id> — Actor / director filmography (764 people)
/people — Actors and directors index
/lists — User lists
/reels — Swipeable trailer feed
/mood — Mood-based discovery (8 moods)
/match-night — Two-person mutual-like movie picker
/watch-together — Synchronized playback room
/watchlist — Saved titles to watch
/watch-history — Finished titles
/start — What should I watch?
/press — Press kit
/support — Support / membership
/disclaimer — In-app disclaimer
/dmca — Copyright & takedowns
/privacy — Privacy
/terms — Terms
/stats — Your year in Reely
/account — Account
/sitemap.xml — Sitemap
/rss.xml — Trending feed

Structured data: JSON-LD WebSite, WebApplication, Organization, Movie, TVSeries, Person, CollectionPage, BreadcrumbList, ItemList. Open Graph and Twitter Cards on every page.

API: /api/* handled by a Cloudflare Worker (search, filter, infinite scroll, season details, watch providers). Static export — Next.js does not run in production.
